newsitem.title: FRANCE: Portuguese economy minister visits Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese economy minister visits Algeria.

text.p: Portuguese Economy Minister Augusto Mateus, heading a team of economic experts, started a two-day visit to Algeria, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Sunday.
Mateus was welcomed at the airport late on Saturday by Algerian State Secretary for Cooperation and Maghreb Arab Affairs, Lahcene Moussaoui, with whom he is to have detailed talks.
The Portuguese minister said on arrival that his country and Algeria "are destined to have privileged relations, notably in economic cooperation".
The delegation is also to attend a seminar on Portugal's experience in privatisation and upgrading its economy to meet demands of the world market.
In November, Algerian, Moroccan, Spanish and Portuguese energy ministers officially opened the natural gas pipeline running from Algeria to Spain and linking up with Portugal.
APS said that Sonatrach had also concluded a deal with the Portuguese firm NAIGAS to deliver 2.1 billion cubic metres of natural liquefied gas. It gave no further details.
